item.title: OnCue 1.2.1
item.description:
OnCue 1.2.1 Release Notes

  • Smart Audio-Only & Live Radio Station Detection with Animated Equalizer Visualizer
  • Automatic Video Recovery Engine: Seamless fallback to raw stream and VideoToolbox GPU transmuxing
  • One-click external player launch (VLC Media Player / IINA) from top bar and recovery modals
  • YouTube Official Trailer Modal with instant Safari companion fallback
  • Multi-Account Management & Zero-interruption Auto-Failover Backup Engine
  • Audio & Subtitle Lip-Sync Delay Adjustment (+/- 0.5s)
  • Smart IMDb Rating & Release Year Filters for Movies and Series
  • VOD Offline Download Engine for Movies & Series episodes
  • macOS Media Center & Keyboard Media Keys Integration (Now Playing)
  • Instant Highlight Clip & Animated GIF Exporter (C shortcut)
  • Apple AirPods Spatial Audio (Uzamsal Ses) Support
  • Cinematic Real-time Ambilight Glow Lighting Effect
  • Universal 2: Native on Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4) & Intel Macs
